title: FLA import: Button symbol decoded as graphic — DefineButton2 lost on publish
description: Golden-pair oracle (fixtures/golden, tools/golden-report.mjs) deviation. The source FLA's 'PlayButton' is a BUTTON symbol: real Flash 8 publishes it as DefineButton2 (records in states UP|OVER|DOWN|HIT referencing the button-face shape). Our loadFla() imports PlayButton as symbolType='graphic' with two single-frame layers (Text, BG) — the Up/Over/Down/Hit state frames and the 'button' symbol type are dropped. Consequence: golden-report shows DefineButton2 ours=0/golden=1 and DefineSprite ours=3/golden=2 (PlayButton compiled as a plain sprite). Fix the binary FLA decoder to recognise the button symbolType and decode the 4 button state frames. Acceptance: node tools/golden-report.mjs shows DefineButton2 1/1 and DefineSprite 2/2. Related (done but not engaging this fixture): 0923, 0089, 0199, 0436.
